execution.activity: Evidence synthesis for the methods-page explanation; no measurement rerun or source admission.

gap.meaning: Area the NTEMS VLCE2 land-cover source did not map, not a measurement of forest or forest loss.

samplingAttempt.conclusion: The attempt could not constrain the forest-loss answer sufficiently. Baseline stand structure cannot be measured directly from surface reflectance.
samplingAttempt.labels: Rule-set labels read the same imagery as the classifier. This is a method comparison, not independent validation or ground reference.

parameterAttribution.measure: Swing in median lower-bound gap rate as each parameter varies, with other parameters varying.

baselineYearTest.conclusion: Moving the baseline to a later year did not narrow the envelope.

britishColumbia.interpretation: Most of the BC gap is shoreline and boundary-edition disagreement against the authoritative GeoBC terrestrial boundary, not unmapped forest.

forestryActivity.finding: Dated records of forestry activity within the unmapped area were reviewed internally.
forestryActivity.publicationLimit: Qualitative statement only. Provincial harvest-record and fire-perimeter hectare quantities are withheld pending source-admission evidence.

findings.neededEvidence: Field plots, air photos or lidar supplying stand structure for the baseline year.
limitations: Research evidence only; not admitted production data.
No gap forest-loss estimate or sampling envelope is authorized for reader-facing copy.
No detection-accuracy claim, source admission, release or gate change. No published province figure changes.
